full_details: At Old Swan Stairs Davy Gannet had Raleigh landed at Plymouth in a ship so deep in gold she would hardly steer. He had told you the first half in February. You asked who off the ship he had spoken with. He had it from a lighter. George Bryan walked up with you and did not buy the gold. In Paul's Walk the phrase was with little riches. Stones that may be ore, a river as wide as a sea, a golden city one nation further up, and men whose heads grow beneath their shoulders, from men who had it from other men. You asked the pillar whether anyone had spoken with a man off the ship. Nobody had. The court had had it yesterday. Drayton had looked for his own name on the Cambridge leaf first. Of Raleigh he said eight months, and a story. You said it was a living. You paid fivepence for a quire and took no title off the sheet. You were at the Theatre by ten with the left side of your face in a scarf. Kemp spent the name. You played the King of Navarre at two and brought no speech of it home. Across the water the Rose had two bills. You did not cross. At dinner the loaf was a penny and a full thumb short, and board was threepence because you sat to it. The coffer stayed shut.
one_sentence: Gannet brought Raleigh home in a ship of gold, Paul's cut it to little riches, and you bought a blank quire for fivepence.
title: Heard little riches at Paul's, and paid fivepence for a quire
